column1: # Team guard rules: matched before Claude Code runs a Bash command; a match denies the command.
# Built-in rules (git force push, recursive delete of the root directory, and so on) are checked first.
# Rules here can only block more, never relax a built-in rule.
# Format: one rule per line, 3 or 4 tab-separated columns
# - rule: name shown in the deny message; use custom/<name> to match .agreements/rules/<name>.md
# - pattern: regular expression. The command is split on && || ; and newlines, and each part is matched separately
# - message: tells the agent why it can't do this and what to do instead
# - allow (optional): a part that also matches this pattern is allowed
# Placeholders: {S} space or tab; {NS} non-space, non-quote; {E} end of word
# Avoid \b \s \d \w and (?…): without python3 the hook falls back to grep -E, which doesn't support them
# Try rules in the Playground first: https://machiko.github.io/agent-working-agreements/
# Broken lines are skipped with a warning at run time; install.sh --sync lists them and --check-drift fails.
